findings: Both T2 roles are actual: original batches label GraphRole3 (draft_rows1,8calls) and4 (draft_rows2,58calls), matching diagnostic Invocation1/2 counts. Each has separate draft/target capture ranges.
All58 recorded first-mismatch tuples differ only in offset. Their descriptors, resource, handle and extent match; later unequal ports in the same key were not exhaustively dumped.

Hidden[1,2048] first differences include same-backing offsets8192,4096,0. In catchup-role draft range, first8 fingerprints follow A,B,C,B,C,A,B,C. A returns after eviction;2variants really reuse B/C but cannot simultaneously hold all3observed tuples.

Target GDN history[1,3,6144] first differences include same-backing offsets0/36864. Per-range immutable plan-step skeleton fingerprint stays unchanged during the detailed window; this is not a serialization of native kernel topology.

There is also explicit invalidation: Invocation1 prepare6 completes with retained hits, then outside prepare two recycle=false calls (steps39/255) discard keys; prepare7 requalifies and records both ranges. Draft fingerprint at7 equals1but no prior key survives.
All captured qualification results are preserving=true; no seal failure is observed. Explicit invalidate_commands is not itself proof of a permission failure or redundant invalidation.
Complete final counters:132range decisions,32recorded,10retained hits,90variant hits. Capture caching is genuinely used.
limits: One initial process had diagnostic overflow, preserved as run1; one root-directed corrected process run2 follows. Neither is TPS or memory evidence.
Only first20prepares per Invocation have detailed keys. The58-call catchup role has10later recordings outside detail; its whole-journey counters remain, not their tuple explanation.
Actual GraphExecUpdate result/errorNode is not visible from this one Graph TU. A rebuild seed can be present but update attempt/success/native topology rejection remain unknown.

Hash repetition is a diagnostic clue, not proof of full tuple equality; exact existing variant-hit decisions remain authoritative. First-mismatch offset equality does not prove every remaining key port is equal.

Raw caller addresses lack a directly captured module base. map-extract.json uses an explicitly labelled relocation inference to locate invalidate_commands; it cannot identify the adapter caller behind that function.

Native permissions/owners are never retained by diagnostic records; original validation, retirement,2variant policy and math are unchanged. No cache enlargement or prewarm timing relocation is proposed.
